name: agent-loop-from-scratch
description: An LLM agent loop written by hand on the Claude Messages API. It categorizes credit card spending, with code for the math and human approval for the model's proposals.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.test: tsx --test src/*.test.ts src/agent/*.test.ts src/eval/*.test.ts src/db/*.test.ts apps/api/src/*.test.ts
